shortBio.en: Iron Maiden founder; eighth-note gallop bass as NWOBHM rhythm DNA.
shortBio.zh: Iron Maiden 创始人；八分疾驰贝斯作为 NWOBHM 节奏 DNA。

body.en:
Born 1956. Writes and drives from bass through Di'Anno and Dickinson eras. Gallop pocket on The Trooper and Number of the Beast is the teaching object.

Continuous seat since 1975; brand architect beside Eddie mascot tech.
body.zh:
1956 年生。跨 Di'Anno 与 Dickinson 时期从贝斯写作并驱动。The Trooper 与 Number of the Beast 上的疾驰律动是教学对象。

自 1975 连续席位；在 Eddie 吉祥物技术旁的品牌架构者。
